בְּתוֹךְ הַיָּם is a rule 29 arthrous rendering: the written article on יָם takes the the standing before its own word (t015) and the construct תָּוֶךְ takes the supplied one (t012). Nothing is fronted.
The resultative הָיָה לְ leaves the preposition unrepresented (rule 21), while the second לְ of לַגּוֹיִם takes its own to and its assimilated article the written the.
